about: The Regiment. Card design and golden lines are in docs/ideation-track-2/tribes/pigeon/.

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: Supply {supply}: At the end of your turn, give this slot {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Territorial
cards.text: Reserve.

cards.name: Recruiting Sergeant
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After a unit in front of this dies, a Private steps in there.

cards.name: Lance Corporal
cards.text: {cost}: Give the slots in front of this {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Old Campaigner
cards.text: At the start of your turn, give this slot {amount} Renown, or {survived} if this survived last fight.

cards.name: Colour Sergeant
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if this row is full of Pigeons, give each slot in it {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Padre
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After a friendly unit dies, give its slot {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Grenadier Guard
cards.text:
{cost}: Make a slot your Guard post.
At the end of your turn, give your Guard post {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Squadron Leader
cards.text: The units in front of this have Sortie and +{attack} Attack.

cards.name: Home Guard
cards.text:
Guard.
Reserve.

cards.name: Flying Ace
cards.text:
Cleave.
Charge {limit}: After this kills, give this slot {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Lieutenant
cards.text: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals half its slot's Renown as damage to the enemy across from it.
cards.golden_text: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals its slot's full Renown as damage to the enemy across from it.

cards.name: Bugler
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After a friendly unit dies, a Private steps in there.

cards.name: Quartermaster
cards.text:
Recruit: Give {reserve_units} in your hand Reserve.
You can call {amount} more reservist each fight.
cards.golden_text:
Recruit: Give {reserve_units} in your hand Reserve.
You can call {amount} more reservists each fight.

cards.name: Colour Ensign
cards.text: Start of fight: This slot copies your highest Renown.
cards.golden_text: Start of fight: This slot and the slots next to it copy your highest Renown.

cards.name: Wing Commander
cards.text:
Sortie.
Charge {limit}: After one of your Pigeons with Sortie kills, give its slot {amount} Renown.

cards.name: Group Captain
cards.text: Your reservists have Sortie and +{attack} Attack.

cards.name: Regimental Sergeant Major
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give every slot {amount} Renown.

cards.name: The Colonel
cards.text: Reservists from your hand have double Renown.
cards.golden_text: Reservists from your hand have triple Renown.

cards.name: Air Marshal
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After a reservist steps in, it attacks immediately.
